description: Non material amendment to approved application DM2026/00160 which allowed the 'Demolition of existing garage and erection of an attached three storey dwelling with parking to front, extension to existing vehicle crossover, provision of detached cycle and refuse stores and new boundary treatment' to allow the conversion of loft space involving a dormer extension at rear, a rooflight to front roofslope, alterations to the ground floor front, right flank and rear fenestrations and ground floor internal alterations.
decision_conditions: The proposed alterations are considered to be materially different from that granted planning permission under planning application DM2026/00160. As such, the proposal would be materially different from the approved scheme and cannot be considered as a non-material amendment to the planning permission under Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).
